---
page-layout: custom
comments: false
body-class: home
---

<div class="hero-overlay">
  <h1 class="hero-title hero-right">
    <span class="hero-static">experiments in</span>
    <span class="tw" aria-live="polite">
      <span class="tw-text"></span><span class="tw-caret" aria-hidden="true">|</span>
    </span>
  </h1>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  // Change these phrases to whatever you want
  const phrases = [
    "machine learning",
    "data science",
    "applied physics"
  ];

  // Tuning knobs
  const typeSpeed = 45;      // ms per character
  const deleteSpeed = 28;    // ms per character
  const holdAfterType = 1100; // pause after typing a phrase
  const holdAfterDelete = 300; // pause after deleting
  const loop = true;
  const deleteBetweenPhrases = true;

  // Respect reduced motion
  const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  const textEl = document.querySelector(".tw-text");
  if (!textEl) return;

  if (prefersReducedMotion) {
    textEl.textContent = phrases[0];
    return;
  }

  let phraseIndex = 0;
  let charIndex = 0;
  let deleting = false;

  function tick() {
    const current = phrases[phraseIndex];

    if (!deleting) {
      charIndex++;
      textEl.textContent = current.slice(0, charIndex);

      if (charIndex >= current.length) {
        if (!deleteBetweenPhrases && loop) {
          phraseIndex = (phraseIndex + 1) % phrases.length;
          charIndex = 0;
          setTimeout(tick, holdAfterType);
          return;
        }
        if (!loop && phraseIndex === phrases.length - 1) return;
        deleting = deleteBetweenPhrases;
        setTimeout(tick, holdAfterType);
        return;
      }

      setTimeout(tick, typeSpeed);
      return;
    }

    // deleting
    charIndex--;
    textEl.textContent = current.slice(0, charIndex);

    if (charIndex <= 0) {
      deleting = false;
      phraseIndex = (phraseIndex + 1) % phrases.length;
      setTimeout(tick, holdAfterDelete);
      return;
    }

    setTimeout(tick, deleteSpeed);
  }

  tick();
})();
</script>


::: light-mode
<div class="bg-wrap">
  <img class="bg-img" src="assets/welcome_light.png" alt="" aria-hidden="true">
</div>
:::

::: dark-mode
<div class="bg-wrap">
  <img class="bg-img" src="assets/welcome_dark.png" alt="" aria-hidden="true">
</div>
:::
